about: Design, UX, UI and design-to-code skills that ship with Layerwright. Copied unchanged from their sources at the commit given (only Markdown files), under their own licenses (LICENSES/). Picked from aiuxplayground.com/skills and the repositories behind it for the four Layerwright jobs.

skills.name: Design Critique
skills.when: Critiquing or polishing a screen in Figma (Polish requests, the critique loop): first impression, usability, hierarchy, consistency, accessibility, with prioritized fixes.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: UX Copy
skills.when: Writing or reviewing the words in a design: button labels, error messages, empty states, CTAs, onboarding.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: User Research
skills.when: Planning research for a design: method choice, interview guides, usability test plans.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Research Synthesis
skills.when: Turning interview notes, survey answers or feedback into themes, insights and design recommendations.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Frontend Design
skills.when: Designing a new screen or page from a brief (in Figma or HTML) with a distinctive, intentional look instead of templated defaults.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Better Layout
skills.when: Grouping, alignment, spacing, reading order and RTL of a screen, in Figma or in code.
skills.author: Jakub Krehel

skills.name: Better Typography
skills.when: Type scale, font choice and pairing, line length, wrapping and truncation.
skills.author: Jakub Krehel

skills.name: Better Colors
skills.when: Building or fixing a colour system: palettes, contrast, semantic tokens, light and dark themes.
skills.author: Jakub Krehel

skills.name: Better UI
skills.when: Visual polish: concentric radius, optical alignment, surfaces and shadows, icons, micro-interactions.
skills.author: Jakub Krehel

skills.name: Design System
skills.when: Auditing, documenting or extending a Design System: naming, hard-coded values, a component's variants, states and props, or a new pattern that fits.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Create DESIGN.md
skills.when: Writing down a product's design language (tokens, type, components, layout rules) as a DESIGN.md from its code or site, before building it in Figma or code.
skills.author: Julien Thibeaut (ibelick)

skills.name: Design Handoff
skills.when: Before implementing a Figma design, or when asked for a spec: layout, tokens, component props, every state, breakpoints, edge cases, motion and accessibility.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Design Engineering
skills.when: Implementing UI in code that should feel right: component design, interaction details, animation decisions (Emil Kowalski).
skills.author: Emil Kowalski

skills.name: Break (every state)
skills.when: After building a component in code: render it in every state and worst-case content on one page and see what breaks.
skills.author: Jakub Krehel

skills.name: Accessibility Review
skills.when: A WCAG 2.1 AA audit of a design: contrast, touch targets, focus order, labels, with fixes.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Better Accessibility
skills.when: Accessibility in code: semantics and ARIA, focus and keyboard, forms, hit areas, reduced motion.
skills.author: Jakub Krehel

skills.name: Animate
skills.when: Adding motion, in a Figma prototype or in code: whether to animate, the property, curve, duration and interruption.
skills.author: Emil Kowalski
